question: LCDs typically have response times in the range of _____ to _____, whereas LEDs are available with response times below _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __10 ms; 30 ms; 100 ns**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• LCD__ stands for Liquid Crystal Display, and __LED__ stands for Light Emitting Diode.
 
• LCDs generally have slower response times, which are typically in the range of 10 ms to 30 ms.
 
• LEDs, on the other hand, offer much faster response times, often below 100 ns, making them highly efficient for display and lighting applications.
 
• The faster response time of LEDs allows them to perform better in dynamic visual applications such as video displays.
 
• This difference in response time makes LEDs a preferred choice for high-speed and high-resolution displays.
 
• LCDs, while slower, are still widely used due to their cost-effectiveness and energy efficiency in various applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **LCD Technology:**
 
 
• LCDs use liquid crystals to modulate light and are commonly used in monitors, TVs, and mobile displays.
 
• They require a backlight for visibility, as the crystals themselves do not emit light.
 
 
 
• **LED Technology:**
 
 
• LEDs are semiconductor devices that emit light when an electric current flows through them.
 
• They are energy-efficient, durable, and capable of providing bright and vibrant displays.
 
• LEDs are often used for backlighting in modern LCDs and for standalone display panels.
